web_fixture.snippet: Walk-in and scheduled notary fees at Ashvale, including the per-document certification fee.
web_fixture.content:
# Notary fees

Ashvale Notary Services, revised 2026-08-14.

Walk-in certification covers oaths, copies and signature witnessing; scheduled evening appointments carry the office surcharge published on this page.

The per-document certification fee and the same-day surcharge are listed in the fee table on this page; invoiced corporate accounts follow the rate card attached to their agreement.

web_fixture.snippet: Office address, walk-in hours and booking lines; the current fee schedule lives on the notary fees page.
web_fixture.content:
# Contact & opening hours

Ashvale Notary Services.

The office takes walk-ins on weekday mornings and booked visits all day; bring the documents unsigned and one form of photo identification.

Current fees are published on the notary fees page; the front desk cannot quote amounts over the phone.
